atlas_v4.robot: Boston Dynamics Atlas v4 (with Multisense head)
notes: Collision geometry in this URDF is analytic (boxes/cylinders/spheres) only,
so no mesh assets are needed for physics and none are vendored into this repo.
MuJoCo imports the URDF with discardvisual=true; PyBullet and Webots consume
the same pinned URDF, so all three simulators run one identical robot.
